name: Displacement Mapping for Volume Rendering
definition: A technique for modeling interactive deformations (cuts, peeling, deforming) on volumetric objects by applying unconventional, unorthogonal, and discontinuous displacements, avoiding mesh re-tessellation.
summary: Displacement Mapping for Volume Rendering enables interactive deformations on volumetric objects via inverse displacement maps, avoiding mesh re-tessellation and supporting discontinuous changes.
